# S2.7 — Information-flow control & taint labeling: `FlowContract`, prospective labels + admission, quarantine, `EnforcementClass`, per-basis endorsement effects, D-ROBUST, check 3, the closed flow-policy language and remedies (R-2.8.2)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5g.2 (the C2 item at Stage 2)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/038_S2.7__ifc-taint-labeling.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.8.2**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s2.6` (stacked) · **Stage:** 2 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)

## Summary

The §5g.2 information-flow slice lands end-to-end: capabilities declare
a canonical `flow_contract`; `Monitor::authorize` computes the
prospective label `L⁺(p) = (ctx ⊔ ⊔L(args)) ⊔ d_τ`, runs D-ROBUST
*before any ask*, evaluates the closed flow-policy language in tier
order (deny → allow/declassify/sanitize → Π's default row), and
enforces check 3 (`recipients(p) ⊆ readers(x)`) on the egress domains.
Result admission stamps the realized `L(r)` — narrowed, realized, or
`unverified` quarantine for unannotated open-world results — never
reading a class from the payload. Endorsements enforce the per-basis
effects table at mint *and* at ledger append. Decisions carry the
closed `Remedy` sum (`remedies[]`, `remedy_taken?`). Advisory
enforcement can only raise restrictions.

### `crates/hh-provenance`

- `flow.rs` (new, ~3.2k lines incl. tests) — the single IFC home
  (CC7): `FlowContract` + the fail-closed canonical codec
  (`to_json`/`from_json` refuse non-objects and unknown members —
  ADR-0269 D4); `prospective_label`/`apply_contribution` (L⁺ ⊒ ctx,
  property-tested); `admit` + `AdmissionKind{realized, narrowed,
  unverified}`; `EnforcementClass`; the closed `Remedy` sum +
  `enumerate_remedies` (R1–R5, attendance-aware); `d_robust`;
  `check_reader_coverage` + `check3_relevant` (world=open ∪
  {net_egress, message_human, spend} ∪ memory_write ≥ project);
  `check_basis_effect` (seal/pin/promotion raise+clear-taint;
  validator pinned `external → environment`, capacity-bounded;
  policy_rule readers-only); `capacity_bits`/`check_shape_endorsement`/
  `apply_sanitizer_bounds` (`CAP_MAX_DEFAULT = 8`);
  `resolve_recipients`; and the closed `FlowCond`/`FlowRule`/
  `FlowSelector`/`FlowDecision` grammar — total evaluation,
  `COND_MAX_DEPTH = 16`/`COND_MAX_NODES = 256` at decode, `And`/`Or`/∀
  evaluate every operand (no secret-dependent early exit).
- `endorse.rs` — `check_basis_effect` enforced inside `endorse`, and
  `check_endorsement` revalidates at append; `LabelEndorsed` gains the
  optional `capacity_bits`/`sanitizer_ref`/`robustness_inputs`
  evidence members (honestly absent unless bounded). `seal` clears
  `to.taint` (ADR-0269 D3); `approval` stays intent-scoped (D2).
- `label.rs`/`decode.rs`/`lib.rs` — `arg_join` covers `handle`
  arguments; `label_bytes` size hook; flow exports.

### `crates/hh-hir`

- `tools.rs` — `validate_capability` parses the `flow_contract`
  member through `FlowContract::from_json` (`SchemaViolation` on
  malformed) and validates every named parameter path against
  `input_schema` (`UnmappedParameter`).
- `ops.rs`/`errors.rs` — `ops::seal` refuses `ContributionUndeclared`
  when `world = open` or domain ∈ {net_egress, message_human,
  fs_read, memory_write} without a contract (typed, fail-closed).

### `crates/hh-monitor`

- `monitor.rs` — `Proposal.flow: FlowInputs{param_labels,
  shape_endorsed, committed, detectors}`; `authorize` step 4 runs
  prospective-label → D-ROBUST → `resolve_recipients` → `check_flow` →
  reader coverage before Π's default path; deterministic ordering
  preserved.
- `decision.rs` — `DenyReason` gains `RobustnessViolated`,
  `ReaderCoverage`, `EvaluationError`; `DecisionRecord` gains
  `remedies[]`/`remedy_taken?`.
- `wire.rs` — the `hh-monitor/authorize-input/1` codec carries the
  flow member; OOP byte-equality + profile invariance tested
  (`oop_flow_contract_byte_identical_and_profile_invariant`).

### `crates/hh-env` / `crates/hh-context`

- `dispatch.rs` — `DispatchInput.flow` passes canonical per-parameter
  labels into the proposal; the observe batch emits
  `context.observation.recorded{admission, label}` **before**
  scope-closing `action.tool.completed` (ADR-0269 D5).
- `observe.rs`/`events.rs` — admission carried + serialized.
- `assemble.rs` — `context_label` skips `handle_only` items; a
  handle inlined into model-facing `Text` is
  `AssemblyError::HandleLeaked` (quarantine stays context-invisible).

### `crates/hh-ledger`

- `classes.rs` — `EFFECT_FIELDS` + `admission`; `DECIDED_FIELDS` +
  `remedies`/`remedy_taken`; `LABEL_FIELDS` + `capacity_bits`/
  `sanitizer_ref`/`robustness_inputs` (the class stays non-audit —
  kind-discriminated payloads only, ADR-0269 D6).

## ADRs

**ADR-0269** — `flow.rs` as the one schema/evaluation home; the
`approval`-basis intent exemption from the per-basis table; `seal`
clears taint; fail-closed contract decode; the recorded-row batch
order; admission/kind members are content-free; the total,
constant-time-per-atom evaluator.
